कार्यालय ज्ञापन (OFFICE MEMORANDUM)

1 Mr. Yogendra Singh, Deputy System Manager has submitted an approved leave application form for foreign visit using Earned Leave from September 17 to November 15, 2024, for a period of 60 days.

2. This Office Memorandum is to notify that as per Central Civil Services (Revised Pay) rules, 2008 in regard to Transport Allowance (T.A.), employee(s) absent from duty for a full calendar month due to leave/training/tour, etc., will not be entitled to draw T.A. for that calendar month.

3. Consequently, T.A. in respect of Mr. Yogendra Singh for the month of October {{ frappe.utils.getdate(doc.leave_start_date).year }} would not be admissible.

4. This Office Memorandum is published in English and Hindi languages. In case of any kind of discrepancy in interpretation, the English version shall prevail.

सहायक कुलसचिव, प्रशासन
Assistant Registrar, Administration
